dimensions.name: Knowledge Delta
dimensions.justification: Provides concrete thresholds (CPU<30%, Memory<50%, bin‑packing ratio >2x, Fargate breakeven 3‑4 pods per node, Spot up to 90% off, Karpenter 20‑40% savings, CSP 50‑72% discount) and a detailed decision tree that a generic model would not enumerate. However most of these numbers are publicly documented, so the added expert insight is moderate rather than maximal.

dimensions.name: Mindset + Appropriate Procedures
dimensions.justification: Provides an AWS‑specific ordered process (pre‑flight, bin‑packing, right‑sizing, Fargate evaluation, Spot checklist, Karpenter migration, Savings Plan) and concrete CLI snippets. Some steps remain generic (e.g., “validate input”) and could include more detailed AWS‑only nuances, but overall the procedure is domain‑specific.

dimensions.name: Anti-Pattern Quality
dimensions.justification: Contains a concrete NEVER list with reasons (e.g., never downsize without checking request‑usage ratio, never use Spot without PDB/NTH). However it omits warnings about mixed‑instance Spot groups, the impact of heterogeneous instance families on bin‑packing, and deeper justification for why Savings Plans never apply to Fargate beyond a brief note.

dimensions.name: Specification Compliance
dimensions.justification: Frontmatter, description, keywords, activation triggers, invocation schema, and example are all present and well‑formed. The "when_to_use" section is slightly vague on exact metric thresholds, which could cause unreliable activation.

dimensions.name: Progressive Disclosure
dimensions.justification: The document layers information (Quick start → Strict output contract → Mindset → Process → References). The Quick start section is dense and includes many details that could overload the initial read, but critical rules are still discoverable without digging into deep references.

dimensions.name: Freedom Calibration
dimensions.justification: Destructive actions are gated by a mandatory CONFIRM step and pre‑flight safety checks (PDB, DaemonSet, Graviton image verification). The only minor over‑grant is allowing a downsize recommendation even when bin‑packing is marked healthy, which could risk pending pods.

dimensions.name: Pattern Recognition
dimensions.justification: Follows a recognizable pattern (Quick start, Mindset, Process, Output contract, References) that aids comprehension. The structure is consistent but not a formally named framework.

dimensions.name: Practical Usability
dimensions.justification: Examples are largely executable, but one Spot recommendation violates the NEVER rule by suggesting a single instance type, uses vague savings notation ("~$1,000"), and omits the required multi‑instance alternatives. These gaps reduce the ability of an agent to act reliably.
